tweets.text: Fortunate to have led the seed round to partner with the company alongside @strikervp and @AltimeterCap.

LLMs are either not capable or not affordable for visual reasoning tasks at scale.

The Elorian team - one of Jeff Dean’s best reports who led Gemini, an Apple LLM lead, xAI lead, and a Harvard professor - just launched an Astra-level visual reasoning model, Glimpse, for 17x cheaper.

Watch it break down the flying Tesla video physics here.

Extremely critical for video inputs in manufacturing, robotics, gaming, content moderation and more.
